review_gate.gate_description: Human must review and approve planning_review_report.md before JiraOrchestrator proceeds

required_files.purpose: All technologies — backend AND frontend, with exact versions
Modules and components — must include type field per component
Auth, roles, permissions — affects both backend middleware and frontend route guards
UI framework, routing, component hierarchy, state management, design system, page layouts, user journeys

blocking_conditions.on_fail: Return PLANNING_BLOCKED. frontend_design.json is required for full-stack planning.

full_stack.description: Has both backend logic (service, API) AND a user-facing frontend (page, form, component)

backend_only.description: Pure backend. No user-facing UI. Other frontend modules consume its API.
backend_only.planning_rule: Plan backend_tasks.json only. frontend_tasks.json = empty array with note.

frontend_only.description: Pure frontend. Consumes existing APIs. No new backend logic.
frontend_only.planning_rule: Plan frontend_tasks.json only. backend_tasks.json = empty array with note.

module_types.missing_type_action: Flag as assumption. Document in planning_review_report.md.

planning_phases.name: bootstrap
planning_phases.constraint: Bootstrap tasks must have zero dependencies outside Phase 1.
planning_phases.parallel_execution: P1A and P1B can run in parallel within Sprint 1.

sub_phases.name: backend_domain_foundation
sub_phases.ordering_rule: Migrations with foreign keys must come after referenced table migrations. Order from domain_model.json → relationships.

sub_phases.name: frontend_foundation
sub_phases.constraint: Phase 2B tasks are purely presentational. No API calls, no state management, no backend dependencies.

planning_phases.name: core_services
planning_phases.description: Feature modules — backend AND frontend tasks together per module. One subfolder per module.
planning_phases.critical_dependency_rule: Every frontend task that makes an API call MUST declare a dependency on the backend task that implements that endpoint.

planning_phases.name: shared_utilities_extraction
planning_phases.description: Scan all phases 1-5 for repeated patterns. Extract to shared utilities. Update all dependencies.
backend_extraction_targets: duplicated_auth_middleware → flag, must be in security module only
frontend_extraction_targets: duplicated_auth_token_injection → flag, must be in API client interceptor only

rules.sprint_3_plus: Feature modules — backend and frontend tasks can share a sprint. Backend API task must be sequenced before frontend page task within sprint.
rules.integration_sprint: Sprint after both modules being integrated are complete
rules.e2e_sprint: Final sprint(s), after all integration tasks
rules.full_stack_principle: Each sprint delivers a working vertical slice — not backend-only or frontend-only

files.description: Master plan — all modules, tasks, sprints, shared utilities, dependency graph
Full DAG — backend and frontend tasks together. Must have no cycles.
Sprint assignments. Each sprint shows backend tasks + frontend tasks + deliverable.
Human review gate. Requires APPROVED status before JiraOrchestrator proceeds.
Module overview: type, tech, dependencies, sprint, risk summary
All backend tasks for the module
All frontend tasks for the module (empty array with note for backend_only modules)
All cross-module integration tasks (BE↔BE, FE↔BE, FE↔FE)
All E2E test tasks per user journey

absolute_rules.rule: Never invent architecture details not present in input files.
Never create circular task dependencies. DAG must be valid.
Never plan a task for a module not in hld.json.
Never assign a task to a sprint without verifying all dependencies are in earlier sprints.
Never skip Phase 1 Bootstrap (both 1A and 1B). Always Sprint 1.
Never plan backend tasks for a module without also planning frontend tasks in the same folder (for full_stack modules).
Never plan a frontend page/component task before its backend API dependency is planned in an earlier sprint.
Never generate JIRA tickets. That is JiraOrchestrator's job.
Always write output to folder paths defined in folder-structure skill.
Always halt if two architecture files contradict each other. Document and request human resolution.

error_conditions.action: Halt. List missing file. Do not proceed.

error_conditions.condition: Two architecture files contradict each other
error_conditions.action: Halt. Document exact field paths. Request human resolution.

error_conditions.condition: Module in hld.json missing type field
error_conditions.action: Default to full_stack. Flag as assumption. Document in review report.

error_conditions.condition: Frontend task calls API not in api_contracts.json
error_conditions.action: Halt. Document missing endpoint. Request architecture update.

error_conditions.condition: Frontend routing path not in frontend_design.json
error_conditions.action: Flag as assumption. Document. Continue with assumed path.
Halt. Document cycle. Request human resolution.
Flag. Recommend splitting. Halt for human review.

error_conditions.condition: Frontend task makes API call but has no backend task dependency
error_conditions.action: Flag as architecture gap. Document. Request clarification.
